ideas.title: 💊 Glucose Insights Pro — $9.99/mo SaaS
ideas.description: Web app that analyzes CGM + pump data with AI. Already built: glucose charts, insulin overlay, AI analysis, endo reports, insurance docs, data chatbot. Revenue model: freemium with $9.99/mo for AI features.
ideas.status: 🔨 MVP Built — needs Stripe keys + polish
ideas.notes: STANDOUT OPPORTUNITY. Full MVP already functional: glucose trend charts, insulin dose overlay, AI-powered pattern analysis, endocrinologist report generator, insurance documentation (Letters of Medical Necessity, PA reports), data chatbot. Freemium model — free basic charts, $9.99/mo unlocks AI analysis, reports, and chatbot. Next steps: Stripe integration, landing page, polish UI.

ideas.title: 📄 Insurance Documentation Generator
ideas.description: Standalone product — auto-generates Letters of Medical Necessity, Prior Authorization reports, and hypo documentation for T1D patients and endo offices. Every T1D patient and endocrinologist needs this.
ideas.status: 🔨 Core built inside Glucose Insights — can standalone
ideas.notes: STANDOUT OPPORTUNITY. Could be spun out as its own service separate from Glucose Insights Pro. Revenue: per-document ($5-15/doc) or monthly subscription ($14.99/mo). Target customers: T1D patients fighting insurance denials, endo offices generating documentation for dozens of patients. Massive pain point — insurance companies deny CGM/pump coverage constantly. This automates the fight.

ideas.title: 📱 AVA Insights iOS App
ideas.description: Native iOS app with HealthKit integration. Auto-pulls CGM data from Apple Health — no CSV upload needed. All the same features as web (charts, AI analysis, reports) but native with push notifications and weekly report cards.
ideas.status: 🚀 iOS app live — Android expansion in progress
ideas.notes: STANDOUT OPPORTUNITY. Native iOS app wrapping Glucose Insights features. Key advantage over web: HealthKit auto-pulls CGM data from Dexcom/Libre via Apple Health — zero friction, no CSV uploads. Push notifications for weekly report cards. $4.99-9.99/mo subscription. Build after web MVP validates the feature set. | 2026-02-22 update: AVA Type 1 is now live on the App Store, validating strong demand. Same-day community feedback included multiple Android requests, and Android build work has started (Kotlin + Jetpack Compose scaffold + successful APK builds).

ideas.title: 💬 Data Chatbot — Chat With Your Glucose
ideas.description: AI chatbot that knows your glucose data and asks lifestyle questions. Proactive insights like 'I see you spike at dinner — are you a late snacker?' Built on Llama 4 Scout (nearly free to run).
ideas.notes: Already built as part of Glucose Insights Pro. Uses Llama 4 Scout for nearly free inference. Chatbot has full context of user's glucose data, insulin doses, and patterns. Asks proactive lifestyle questions to correlate habits with glucose spikes. Could also be a standalone widget/API for other diabetes apps.

ideas.title: 🏫 T1D School Kit Generator
ideas.description: Generate 504 plans, nurse instructions, and emergency action plans pre-filled with child's data and settings. Huge for T1D parents navigating school systems.
ideas.notes: Every T1D parent goes through this nightmare every school year. Documents needed: 504 Plan, Individualized Health Plan, Emergency Action Plan, nurse training instructions, field trip protocols, substitute teacher info sheets. Currently parents do this manually or pay lawyers. AI can generate all of these pre-filled with the child's specific insulin doses, carb ratios, and emergency contacts.

ideas.title: 🧠 Diabetes Burnout Tracker
ideas.description: Track engagement with diabetes management over time. Detect signs of burnout (fewer boluses, missing readings, rising A1C). Supportive messaging, not punitive.
ideas.notes: Diabetes burnout is real and under-addressed. Tracks patterns: fewer boluses over time, gaps in CGM readings, rising estimated A1C, skipped site changes. Instead of nagging, provides supportive check-ins and connects to mental health resources. Could be a module in Glucose Insights or standalone app.

ideas.title: 🍕 Carb Counting Trainer
ideas.description: Interactive food photos — guess the carbs, get scored. Restaurant menu database. Meal impact scoring tied to actual glucose data.
ideas.notes: Gamified carb counting practice. Show food photos, user guesses carbs, get scored. Level up accuracy over time. Restaurant menu database with carb counts. Advanced mode: ties actual meal entries to post-meal glucose spikes to show how accurate your counting really is. Great for newly diagnosed T1Ds learning to count carbs.

ideas.title: 👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Multi-User Family Dashboard
ideas.description: See Kam + Kaislyn's glucose side by side. Caregiver view for grandparents, babysitters to see at a glance. Alert forwarding to multiple family members.
ideas.notes: Family dashboard showing multiple T1D family members' glucose in one view. Kam and Kaislyn side by side. Caregiver mode with simplified view — grandparents and babysitters can check glucose without needing to understand all the numbers. Alert forwarding: route urgent lows to multiple phones. Could be a premium tier of Glucose Insights ($14.99/mo family plan).

ideas.title: 📖 Memorial Pages SaaS
ideas.description: AI-powered memorial websites sold through funeral homes. Funeral home pays $50/page wholesale, charges family $149-199. Family pays $249 lifetime hosting directly on the page. AI generates narrative from obituary + historical newspaper research. 99% margins. Funeral home branding on every page = permanent advertising.
ideas.notes: MVP in progress — template system, intake form, Cloudflare Worker + Claude API, sales page. Rhodes memorial is the live demo. 22 funeral homes identified within 50mi of Fort White FL. Gateway-Forest Lawn (Lake City) is #1 target — owner's wife is from Fort White. Strategy: offer first 2-3 pages FREE per funeral home, let family reactions sell the product. Full action plan: memorial-mvp/ACTION-PLAN.md | Business plan: memorial-saas-idea.md | Funeral home list: memorial-mvp/funeral-homes-50mi-fort-white.md | Conservative: $52k/yr (5 homes). Moderate: $212k/yr (20). Optimistic: $667k/yr (50). DEMO SITE: https://gentlytold.pages.dev | LIVE EXAMPLE: https://ava-type1.github.io/rhodes-memorial/ | Domain: GentlyTold.com (buying Tue Feb 11)

ideas.title: 📖 LifeBook — Private Digital Baby Book
ideas.description: Beautiful private digital baby book that turns quick photos and notes into AI-written life story. Not a social feed — a NARRATIVE. Hand your kid a beautiful website on their 18th birthday. Same infrastructure as Memorial Pages.
ideas.status: 💡 Idea — builds on Memorial Pages infra
ideas.notes: Competitors (Tinybeans, Qeepsake, FamilyAlbum, Growbook) are all 'private Instagram for baby' — none do AI narrative or keepsake websites. Shares template engine with Memorial Pages. Parenting apps market: $2.8B by 2029. Revenue: freemium app + printed books + lifetime web hosting.

ideas.title: 🏥 T1D Benefits Navigator
ideas.description: PWA that matches T1D families with patient assistance programs based on income, insurance, and needs. Input info once, see what you qualify for.
ideas.notes: DEPLOYED: https://t1d-benefits-navigator.pages.dev | 30+ programs, smart eligibility scoring, installable PWA. GitHub: ava-type1/t1d-benefits-navigator. Needs traffic and awareness to validate.

ideas.title: 💉 CGM Data Aggregator API (DiabetesData.io)

ideas.notes: Only Dexcom has accessible API. Libre restricted, Medtronic closed. May pivot to 'Dexcom API made easy' wrapper. Prototype at ava-type1/diabetesdata-io. Dexcom partner intake submitted.

ideas.title: 📼 VHS Vault — Nostalgic Video Library App
ideas.description: iPhone app that turns your video collection into a virtual VHS shelf. Upload videos, each one gets a VHS tape with a sharpie-on-white-label title. Browse your shelf, pull a tape, watch it. Pure nostalgia UI.
ideas.notes: Nostalgia play targeting millennials/Gen X. Key features: realistic VHS shelf UI (wooden shelf, worn tape spines), auto-generated sharpie handwriting labels from video title or AI-detected content, VHS static/tracking effect on playback start, optional CRT TV filter overlay, organize by "shelves" (Family, Vacations, Holidays). Monetization: free (10 tapes) → $4.99 unlimited or $2.99/mo. Could go viral on TikTok with the aesthetic. SwiftUI build, PhotosUI for import, AVFoundation for playback with retro filters. Low effort MVP — mostly UI/UX polish.
